read.en: Intel fell 3.2% on Oct 12 to $101.35, its fourth loss in five sessions and 13% below the Oct 5 close. It is below its 5, 10, 30 and 100-day averages (the last two both near $108), though still 22% above the rising 200-day ($83). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 5 with a widening histogram, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since the same day, and RSI is 40.
read.zh: 英特尔 10月12日下跌 3.2%，收于 $101.35，五个交易日中第四次下跌，较 10月5日收盘价下跌 13%。股价位于 5 日、10 日、30 日和 100 日均线（后两者均约 $108）下方，但仍高于上行的 200 日均线（$83）22%。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线下方且柱体扩大，抛物线 SAR 同日转空，RSI 为 40。

read.en: The May pivot at $102.4 gave way (low $100.71), so $100 is the line to watch, then $98.3 (June pivot) and $94.5 (September low). The broken $102.4–104.7 area is now first resistance, then the 30 and 100-day averages near $108 and $114 (Sep 29 swing high).
read.zh: 5月转折点 $102.4 已失守（低点 $100.71），需关注 $100，其次 $98.3（6月转折点）和 $94.5（9月低点）。已跌破的 $102.4–104.7 区域成为第一阻力，其上为约 $108 的 30 日和 100 日均线，以及 $114（9月29日波段高点）。
